before.name: PTree.Eq.FreeOmega.Algebra.peutt_bind_Proper
before.type:
@Algebra.peutt_bind_Proper
     : forall (E MN : Type -> Type) (NI : Measure.SemanticMeasure MN)
         (NC : @Measure.SemanticMeasureCoreLaws MN NI),
       @AE.SemanticMeasureAELiftLaws MN NI ->
       forall NO : @Omega.SemanticOmega MN NI,
       @Coupling.SemanticMeasureCouplingAELaws MN NI ->
       @AE.SemanticMeasureCountableAELaws MN NI ->
       forall A B : Type,
       @Morphisms.Proper
         (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN A ->
          (A -> PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN B) -> PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN B)
         (@Morphisms.respectful (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN A)
            ((A -> PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN B) -> PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN B)
            (@PEutt.peutt E MN (Definition.FreeOmega MN)
               (@Measure.FreeOmegaObservableSemanticMeasure MN NI NO)
               (@Measure.FreeOmegaObservableSemanticMeasureCoreLaws MN NI NC NO)
               (@StructuralMeasure.FreeOmegaMixedMeasure MN)
               (@Measure.FreeOmegaObservableSemanticOmega MN NI NO) A A
               (@eq A))
            (@Morphisms.respectful (A -> PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN B)
               (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN B)
               (@Morphisms.pointwise_relation A (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN B)
                  (@PEutt.peutt E MN (Definition.FreeOmega MN)
                     (@Measure.FreeOmegaObservableSemanticMeasure MN NI NO)
                     (@Measure.FreeOmegaObservableSemanticMeasureCoreLaws MN NI NC NO)
                     (@StructuralMeasure.FreeOmegaMixedMeasure MN)
                     (@Measure.FreeOmegaObservableSemanticOmega MN NI NO) B B
                     (@eq B)))
               (@PEutt.peutt E MN (Definition.FreeOmega MN)
                  (@Measure.FreeOmegaObservableSemanticMeasure MN NI NO)
                  (@Measure.FreeOmegaObservableSemanticMeasureCoreLaws MN NI NC NO)
                  (@StructuralMeasure.FreeOmegaMixedMeasure MN)
                  (@Measure.FreeOmegaObservableSemanticOmega MN NI NO) B B
                  (@eq B)))) (@PTreeDefinition.PTree.bind E MN A B)
before.assumptions:
Axioms:
FunctionalExtensionality.functional_extensionality_dep :
  forall (A : Type) (B : A -> Type) (f g : forall x : A, B x), (forall x : A, f x = g x) -> f = g
Eqdep.Eq_rect_eq.eq_rect_eq :
  forall (U : Type) (p : U) (Q : U -> Type) (x : Q p) (h : p = p), x = @eq_rect U p Q x p h

after.name: PTree.Eq.Algebra.peutt_bind_Proper
